title.zh: v2rayN 启用 VLESS Reality 与 Hysteria 2 实操：新一代抗封锁协议参数详解
title.en: v2rayN VLESS Reality & Hysteria 2 In-Depth: Next-Gen Anti-Censorship Protocols Configuration

description.zh: 手把手教你在 v2rayN 中配置当前最具抗封锁能力的现代网络协议。详解 VLESS-Reality 伪装 SNI、公钥 Public Key 与 ShortId 配置，以及基于 UDP 的 Hysteria 2 拥塞控制与端口跳跃调优。
description.en: Step-by-step tutorial on deploying modern anti-censorship protocols in v2rayN. Detailed analysis of VLESS-Reality SNI camouflage, public keys, ShortIds, and Hysteria 2 UDP congestion control and port-hopping.
